name: treasury-report
title: Treasury report
for_each: select id, name from entities order by code

sections.title: Cash by account
sections.sql: select p.account, p.bank, p.name, p.currency, p.as_of, p.balance_cents, p.base_cents as in_base_cents from account_position p join entities e on e.code = p.entity where e.id = $1 order by p.account

sections.title: Facilities
sections.sql: select s.code, s.lender, s.kind, s.currency, s.limit_cents, s.drawn_cents, s.headroom_cents, s.maturity_on, s.review_on from facility_status s join facilities f on f.id = s.id where f.entity_id = $1 order by s.maturity_on

sections.title: Covenants
sections.sql: select s.code, s.name, s.test, s.threshold, s.value, s.passed, s.headroom_pct, s.certificate_due_on, s.certificate_sent_on from covenant_status s join covenants c on c.id = s.id join facilities f on f.id = c.facility_id where f.entity_id = $1 order by s.code

sections.title: Open hedges
sections.sql: select code, counterparty, currency, direction, notional_cents, contract_rate, settles_on, designated from hedges where entity_id = $1 and status = 'open' order by settles_on

sections.title: Policy exceptions for the group
sections.note: Each line cites the rule it breaks.
sections.sql: select issue, record, rule from compliance_checks where $1::uuid is not null order by rule, record

name: hedge-documentation
title: Hedge relationship documentation
for_each: select id, code as name from hedges where designated and status = 'open' order by code

sections.title: Hedging instrument
sections.sql: select h.code, h.instrument, h.counterparty, h.direction, h.currency, h.notional_cents, h.contract_rate, h.traded_on, h.settles_on from hedges h where h.id = $1

sections.title: Hedged item
sections.sql: select x.code, x.description, x.direction, x.currency, x.amount_cents, x.expected_on, x.basis from hedges h join exposures x on x.id = h.exposure_id where h.id = $1

sections.title: Designation
sections.note: NZ IFRS 9 and AASB 9 paragraph 6.4.1(b) ask for formal designation and documentation at inception, including the risk management objective and how effectiveness is assessed. Complete the objective and the effectiveness method before this is filed.
sections.sql: select h.designation_ref as reference, h.designated_on, (h.designated_on - h.traded_on) as days_after_trade, 'Foreign currency risk on a highly probable forecast transaction' as risk_hedged, case when x.id is null then null else round(100.0 * h.notional_cents / x.amount_cents, 1) end as hedge_ratio_pct from hedges h left join exposures x on x.id = h.exposure_id where h.id = $1

name: bank-mandate
title: Bank mandate review
for_each: select id, code || ' ' || bank as name from bank_accounts where status = 'open' order by code

sections.title: Account
sections.sql: select code, bank, name, number_masked, currency, purpose from bank_accounts where id = $1

sections.title: Current signatories
sections.note: Anyone who has left the business must come off the mandate. Send the bank's change form, then record the removal.
sections.sql: select p.name as person, p.role, p.status, p.left_on, s.authority, s.added_on from signatories s join people p on p.id = s.person_id where s.account_id = $1 and s.removed_on is null order by p.name
